definitions.explanation: formally filing a criminal complaint with prosecutors or police by the victim of a crime

examples.japanese: {被害者|ひがいしゃ}が{告訴|こくそ}した。
{詐欺|さぎ}{罪|ざい}で{告訴|こくそ}する。
{告訴|こくそ}を{取|と}り{下|さ}げることにした。
examples.english: They decided to drop the charges.

examples.japanese: {名誉毀損|めいよきそん}で{告訴|こくそ}される{可能性|かのうせい}がある。
examples.english: There is a possibility of being charged with defamation.

notes:
{告訴|こくそ} is a legal term referring to the formal act of a crime victim filing a criminal complaint with authorities.

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
- {告|こく} (announce, tell, accuse)
- {訴|そ} (sue, complain, accuse)

USAGE:
- {告訴|こくそ}する (to press charges, to file a complaint - suru verb)
- {告訴|こくそ}を{取|と}り{下|さ}げる (to drop charges)
- {告訴|こくそ}{状|じょう} (written complaint)

LEGAL DISTINCTION:
- {告訴|こくそ}: filed by the VICTIM of the crime
- {告発|こくはつ}: filed by a THIRD PARTY (anyone, not necessarily the victim)
- This distinction is important in Japanese criminal law

KEY CONCEPTS:
- {親告罪|しんこくざい} (crimes prosecutable only upon complaint) - some crimes require the victim's {告訴|こくそ} to prosecute
- {告訴|こくそ}{権|けん} (right to file charges)
- {告訴|こくそ}{期間|きかん} (period for filing charges)

COMMON CHARGES:
- {詐欺|さぎ}で{告訴|こくそ}する (to charge with fraud)
- {名誉毀損|めいよきそん}で{告訴|こくそ}する (to charge with defamation)
- {窃盗|せっとう}で{告訴|こくそ}する (to charge with theft)

RELATED TERMS:
- {告発|こくはつ} (accusation by third party)
- {起訴|きそ} (indictment, prosecution)
- {被害届|ひがいとどけ} (damage report to police)
- {訴訟|そしょう} (lawsuit, litigation)
